clue.text: Powerful cat catching one insect

parts.note: an everyday word for a cat
the Roman numeral for one
a common insect

explanation.definitionFit: Puissant is a literary adjective meaning mighty or strong, so it is a synonym of powerful.

clue.text: Particles possibly making person sick

clue.text: Fancy that fish being offered to poor nun!

clue.text: Cloying sweetness of US gentleman on horseback?

clue.text: Beer given to you makes you calm, as before
